name: splice_nodes
declaration: unsafe fn splice_nodes (& mut self , existing_prev : Option < NonNull < Node < T > > > , existing_next : Option < NonNull < Node < T > > > , mut splice_start : NonNull < Node < T > > , mut splice_end : NonNull < Node < T > > , splice_length : usize ,)
documentation:
Splices a series of nodes between two existing nodes.

 Warning: this will not check that the provided node belongs to the two existing lists.
rules: The caller must ensure that the provided nodes belong to the two existing lists; `splice_nodes` does not check this.
